# KeepPeek Svelte 5 Instructions

Before changing matching files, read and follow [the Pragmatic Svelte 5 Guidelines](svelte5_pragmatic_guidelines.md).

Treat every applicable `M-*` rule as required. New code must use modern Svelte 5 patterns; do not introduce legacy reactive declarations, `export let`, directive event handlers, event dispatchers, or slots.
